Country flags: flag-icons by Panayiotis Lipiridis — https://github.com/lipis/flag-icons (MIT License, see LICENSE.txt).
Files: flags/4x3/<iso>.svg (main branch, downloaded 2026-11-05), rasterised to 640x480 PNG with macOS Quick Look
(qlmanage -t -s 640) and cropped to 4:3. Regenerate with Tools/worldmap/README.md.
